import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the visual style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep

scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep',

                                s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Set titles and labels

plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=14)
